snippet.title: Undying Flower Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Undying Flower is coming to Steam on May 16th 2025!

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180670/Undying_Flower/

Undying Flower is a Strange Storytelling of Freaky Imaginations, an interactive storytelling 3D adventure game where you explore the character’s traumatic memory as seen by "The Flower" and try to erase it.
